headline: Towhid Hridoy hits maiden Test century to lead Bangladesh fightback
summary: The 24-year-old batter reached 100 off 171 balls, holding the innings together as Bangladesh faced a tough challenge against West Indies in Sylhet.
details: Towhid Hridoy struck his first Test century on the third day of the second Test against West Indies in Sylhet, reaching the milestone off 171 balls with 11 fours and a six.

headline_marked: Police suspect arson: [[BRTC bus burned in Khagrachhari]]
headline: Police suspect arson: BRTC bus burned in Khagrachhari
summary: A bus operating on the Khagrachhari-Chattogram route was set ablaze while parked; a sleeping assistant escaped unharmed.
details: A Bangladesh Road Transport Corporation (BRTC) bus was destroyed by fire in the Mahajan Para area of Khagrachhari on Saturday morning.
The fire broke out around 4 am, starting at the back of the vehicle while it was parked.
A driver's assistant who was sleeping inside the bus managed to escape just in time after noticing the flames.
Firefighters arrived quickly and brought the blaze under control within 10 minutes, reporting minimum damages of Tk 100,000.
Khagrachhari Sadar Police Station chief Md Kay Kislu stated that investigators suspect the vehicle was deliberately set on fire under cover of darkness.
Police are currently reviewing CCTV footage to identify the perpetrators and are preparing to file a formal case.
caption:
A BRTC bus was reduced to ashes in Khagrachhari early Saturday morning. Police suspect it was deliberately set ablaze.

A Bangladesh Road Transport Corporation (BRTC) bus was destroyed by fire in the Mahajan Para area of Khagrachhari on Saturday morning.

The fire broke out around 4 am, starting at the back of the vehicle while it was parked.

A driver's assistant who was sleeping inside the bus managed to escape just in time after noticing the flames.

Firefighters arrived quickly and brought the blaze under control within 10 minutes, reporting minimum damages of Tk 100,000.

Khagrachhari Sadar Police Station chief Md Kay Kislu stated that investigators suspect the vehicle was deliberately set on fire under cover of darkness.

Police are currently reviewing CCTV footage to identify the perpetrators and are preparing to file a formal case.
